# Rimstone Technical Diving

> Rimstone Technical Diving is a technical diving instruction company based in Fort White, Florida, in the heart of North Florida's Cave Country. It teaches sidemount, cave, open-circuit technical (decompression and trimix), and closed-circuit rebreather (CCR) courses, plus cave guiding and mentoring.

Rimstone is led by Tim Perrault, a TDI Technical Instructor and PADI Technical Instructor Trainer. CCR training focuses on the KISS Sidewinder and AP Inspiration rebreathers. Courses follow TDI and PADI technical pathways.

Key facts:

- Location: Fort White, Florida 32038, USA (North Florida springs / Cave Country)
- Website: https://rimstonediving.com
- Pricing: quoted on request (not published, as is standard for technical and cave diving instruction)
- Email: tim@rimstonediving.com
- Phone: +1 (206) 227-9715 (call, text or WhatsApp)
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 5:00 (Eastern Time); closed Saturday and Sunday
- Instructor credentials: TDI Technical Instructor, PADI Technical Instructor Trainer
- Agencies: TDI (Technical Diving International), PADI (Tec Rec)

## Courses

- [Sidemount Diving](https://rimstonediving.com/sidemount): Streamlined, balanced diving with independent side-mounted cylinders, from Sidemount Fundamentals through Cave-Ready Sidemount. Typically 2 to 3 days. Prerequisites: Open Water certification, core buoyancy skills, medically fit to dive.
- [Cave Diving](https://rimstonediving.com/cave): Overhead training in North Florida's springs, progressing from Cavern Diver and Intro to Cave Diver to Full Cave Diver. Focus on guideline use, failure management and conservation. Typically 5 to 10 days. Nitrox recommended.
- [Technical Diving](https://rimstonediving.com/technical): Decompression procedures, gas management and extended-range planning. Levels: Technical Foundations (PADI Tec Basics / TDI Intro to Tech), Decompression Diver (PADI Tec 40, 45, 50 / TDI Advanced Nitrox & Decompression Procedures), Mixed Gas & Trimix (PADI Tec 65 / Tec 100). Typically 4 to 6 days.
- [Rebreather (CCR) Courses](https://rimstonediving.com/rebreather): Closed-circuit training on the KISS Sidewinder and AP Inspiration. Levels: CCR Air Diluent, CCR Air Diluent Decompression, CCR Mixed Gas & Trimix, CCR Cave Cross-Over, TDI CCR Cave Progression. Typically 4 to 7 days.
- [Try a Rebreather / Demo](https://rimstonediving.com/tryout): Introductory try-dive experiences for divers curious about sidemount or rebreather diving.

## Services

- [Professional Services](https://rimstonediving.com/services): Cave guiding in North Florida's springs and one-on-one mentoring for certified technical and cave divers.

## About and contact

- [About Rimstone](https://rimstonediving.com/about): Background on the instructor and the training philosophy. A rimstone is a natural stone dam built slowly by mineral deposits; the name reflects skills built "one dive at a time."
- [Contact](https://rimstonediving.com/contact): Booking enquiries and questions about courses, scheduling and prerequisites.
